topIssues.title: Remove Code skipping L2ProxyAdmin version check
topIssues.author: 0xiamflux
topIssues.body:
## Description
The ProxyAdmin contract currently lacks a `version()` function. To avoid reverts during version downgrade checks in `L2ContractsManager`, the `L2ProxyAdmin` is currently skipped. This function is planned for inclusion in a future upgrade.

This issue tracks the removal of the logic that skips the `L2ProxyAdmin` check once the `version()` function is available.

topPRs.title: feat(altda): fallback to L1 if AltDA fails
topPRs.author: robert-e-davidson3
topPRs.body:
**Description**

If communication with the AltDA server fails then switch to the usual DA approach: putting everything on the L1.

Minor points:
- Switching from `*txmgr.Queue` to `TxSender` to facilitate mocking/testing.
- No locking is used for setting `l.altDAFallbackActive`. I think this is fine because it will only be set once.

**Tests**

- The tests are written by AI with only some guidance in scope and how to handle mocking.
- The test coverage is increased by adding some tests for AltDA _without_ fallback.

topPRs.title: feat(consensus): implement InMemorySize for op types
topPRs.author: gakonst
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Port of [alloy-rs/op-alloy#624](https://github.com/alloy-rs/op-alloy/pull/624) — implement `alloy_consensus::InMemorySize` for op consensus types.

## Changes

- Bump `alloy-consensus` min to 1.6.2 (which includes `InMemorySize`)
- Add `InMemorySize` impls for: `OpTxType`, `TxDeposit`, `OpDepositReceipt`, `OpReceipt`, `OpTypedTransaction`, `OpPooledTransaction`, `OpTxEnvelope`

## Testing

`cargo check -p op-alloy-consensus` passes.

Prompted by: mattsse
